name: vsphere-triage
description: vSphere VM incident triage: read-only MCP server plus the vm-incident diagnosis skill

username.title: vCenter username
username.description: A read-only service account (shared across vCenters unless overridden per-vCenter in the JSON)

password.title: vCenter password
password.description: Stored in the OS secure credential store

env_parent_hints.title: Environment parent folders (optional)
env_parent_hints.description: VSPHERE_ENV_PARENT_HINTS: folder names that group environments, searched first, e.g. environments,projects

ca_bundle.title: CA bundle path (optional)
ca_bundle.description: VSPHERE_CA_BUNDLE: a PEM bundle for an internal CA; leave blank to use the system trust store

vrops_url.title: vROps URL (optional)
vrops_url.description: VSPHERE_VROPS_URL: Aria / VCF Operations base URL; leave blank to disable the vROps history tools

vrops_username.title: vROps username (optional)
vrops_username.description: VSPHERE_VROPS_USERNAME: required only if vROps URL is set

vrops_password.title: vROps password (optional)
vrops_password.description: Stored in the OS secure credential store

powerflex_url.title: PowerFlex Gateway URL (optional)
powerflex_url.description: VSPHERE_POWERFLEX_URL: Dell PowerFlex (ScaleIO / VxFlex) Gateway base URL; leave blank to disable the backend-health tools

powerflex_username.title: PowerFlex username (optional)
powerflex_username.description: VSPHERE_POWERFLEX_USERNAME: required only if the PowerFlex URL is set

powerflex_password.title: PowerFlex password (optional)
powerflex_password.description: Stored in the OS secure credential store

guest_username.title: Guest-OS username (optional)
guest_username.description: VSPHERE_GUEST_USERNAME: default credentials for run_in_guest (the one non-read-only tool); leave blank to require them per call

guest_password.title: Guest-OS password (optional)
guest_password.description: Stored in the OS secure credential store

index_url.title: Python package index
index_url.description: Where uvx fetches vsphere-triage from. Leave as public PyPI for internet-connected installs; set to an internal PyPI mirror for air-gapped installs.
